positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed and enhanced GrowthOS Brief, an enterprise platform supporting advertising campaign planning and workflow management, using React, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server.

• Designed and developed full-stack features, including responsive React interfaces, backend services, and REST APIs.
• Built and integrated RESTful and federated APIs to enable communication between internal platform services.
• Developed event-driven workflows and integrated AWS services to support asynchronous processing and communication between distributed systems.
• Enhanced brief lifecycle management, version control, status transitions, and artifact update workflows.
• Developed data access logic using Entity Framework Core and SQL Server to support enterprise applications.
• Contributed to AI tooling using Python and FastMCP, building MCP-based integrations.
• Collaborated with Product, QA, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver features, resolve production issues, and improve reliability.

positions.locationName: Lynbrook, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design, development, and modernization of enterprise software applications for air cargo, freight forwarding, and logistics operations using C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and SQL Server.

• Led software development projects, including technical design, implementation, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise solutions.
• Designed and implemented a centralized message processing architecture using IBM MQ, C#, .NET, and SQL Server to streamline airline cargo message processing.
• Developed and maintained a Freight Forwarding Payment Portal, building backend services, REST APIs, and database integrations to support payment processing and financial workflows.
• Built and enhanced enterprise applications to automate air cargo and logistics workflows, reducing manual processes and improving operational efficiency.
• Modernized legacy applications by migrating Classic ASP functionality to .NET, improving maintainability and scalability.
• Designed and optimized SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and data access layers to improve application performance.
• Collaborated with engineering teams and business stakeholders to resolve production issues, improve system reliability, and deliver new features.
